reason: The diagnostic showed me exactly which chapters my child is weak in, which ChatGPT and YouTube never do, and the teacher actually checks it in class. At ₹249 a month with the no-improvement guarantee, I'll keep it going after the pilot, but monthly so I can drop it if the data promise turns out to be just words.
objection: I don't want my child's data going to some AI company. A written promise is nice, but I want to see the actual signed document and know who Edurance really is before I trust it with my kid's school performance.
would_change_my_mind: If the school can't show me the signed data agreement, or I hear from my relative that the gap topics didn't improve on the re-test, I'd stop.
